title: script.read_script_structure input
description: Returns one version's scenes with their dialogue lines and shots, paged by scene ordinal. Separate from reading the version row because the two answer different questions: the row says which version exists, the structure IS the artifact. The duration returned is summed over ALL the version's scenes, not over the page.

versionId.description: The script version whose content to read.

sceneFrom.description: The first scene ordinal to return, counting from one. Omitted or zero starts at the first scene.

sceneTo.description: The last scene ordinal to return, inclusive. Omitted, zero, or past the end runs to the version's last scene.
